This report is public and linked to your GitHub account. Do not include prompts, source text, private URLs, credentials, task IDs, full logs or local identity/database files.

- Public discovery/listing URL:
- Installed version or commit:
- OS and Python major/minor:
- Did MCP discover both tools?
- Was this an installation test, demo, internal project work, or a real task independent of ResultGate development?
- Non-confidential task category (optional):
- Was this useful? What failed?
- Have you returned on a later UTC date for another real task? (optional):

Optional aggregate usage exports may be shared only after reviewing PRIVACY.md; they contain a persistent random installation identifier and daily counts. No export is required.
Reports are unverified until reviewed. Tests, downloads and bot traffic are not qualified real task use.
